item: Rating (and XP/level/league/card stats) do not refresh after a ranked game until the app is restarted
summary: The app reads the account's ratings (GET /v1/me → useAuth.me.ratings) only at app start (initAuth). After a game there is exactly one re-read: the results route's leave(), which runs only when the player presses "לבית" or "משחק חדש" on the results screen (apps/mobile/app/results/[id].tsx). Every other way out never re-reads the ratings: Android back or the iOS swipe from results (the results route has no BackHandler), leaving from the game screen (OnlineGame onHome, the black-screen cases), leaving a running game (abandonment), and the app going to the background and back. Home's focus effect re-reads /v1/me only when meOffline is true (HomeScreen.tsx:94). The app-foreground listener refreshes only /v1/me/progress (appProgress.ts startProgress). There is also a race: the server stores the result, ratings and XP in the background after it broadcasts gameOver (GameRecorder.end, queued behind event batches, with retries). So a quick "לבית" can read the old row, and nothing reads it again. The fix has four parts: (1) detect the end of a ranked game in the session layer, independent of navigation; (2) show the server-computed rating change at once, in memory only; (3) re-read /v1/me with backoff until the server's games count for the rating key goes up, then refresh progress and the player card; (4) make Home's focus and the app's foreground re-read /v1/me, throttled. This is client-only, with no protocol or server change.

rootCauses.cause: Only one refresh point, tied to the results screen's buttons. Any other exit never re-reads /v1/me: Android hardware back or the iOS swipe from /results (it pops to /game-type and leaves the online session in the store), the game screen's home after an end without results (the black-screen reports), and leaving a running game. Home's focus re-reads /v1/me only when the profile came from the phone's cache.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/mobile/app/results/[id].tsx:28-37: leave() is the only refreshMe after a game, called from goHome/newGame only. There is no BackHandler in screens/results (grep: none). app/game.tsx:8 router.replace results, so the stack is [index, modes, game-type, results]. apps/mobile/src/screens/home/HomeScreen.tsx:90-98: `if (useAuth.getState().meOffline) void refreshMe();`. ProfileCard, ModesScreen:54, GameTypeScreen:62 and GameScreen:278 all read useAuth.me.ratings.

rootCauses.cause: The app returning to the foreground never re-reads /v1/me, only progress. A full restart (initAuth → GET /v1/me) is the only other refresh, which matches Moshe's 'closed and reopened, then it updated'.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/mobile/src/progress/appProgress.ts startProgress(): the AppState 'active' handler calls practiceSync().flush() and refreshMyProgress() only. authStore.ts initAuth/loadProfile is the only other getMe.

rootCauses.cause: Race with the server's background write. GameRoom broadcasts the over events first, and GameRecorder writes the end transaction (ratings games+1, XP, histories) in a queue behind event batches with retries (500 ms doubling, 5 tries). A fast 'לבית' reads the old rating, and Home's refreshMyProgress on focus reads the old XP/league/card. Nothing reads again later.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/server/src/rooms/GameRoom.ts:602-611 onGameUpdate (sendEvents, then the recorder runs in the background; match.over() waits on recorder.done). apps/server/src/persistence/recorder.ts end()/enqueue()/withRetries. apps/server/src/ratings/store.ts applyRatingChanges (games + 1 per RatingChange). The server's own fake client already has to poll: apps/server/src/testing/fakeClient/client.ts:779-801 readStoredRating ('GET /v1/me until the game counts in the rating key').

rootCauses.cause: Leaving a running 2-player ranked game: the session is closed before the end. The server records the abandonment loss about graceMs later, and nothing on the phone reads it.
rootCauses.evidence: apps/mobile/src/game/onlineSession.ts close() unsubscribes before any end. app/game.tsx leaveTo → clear() on unmount. GameRoom.ts doc lines 64-70: a consented leave is a disconnect, and the grace ends in abandonment.

files.change: Add accountConfig.refresh: minIntervalMs 30000; afterRanked: confirmDelaysMs [1500,3000,6000,12000,24000], unratedDelaysMs [1500,6000], optimisticTtlMs 120000, afterGraceMarginMs 2000.
Add pure helpers: ratingEntryAfter, withRatingEntry, the PendingRating type, and withPendingRatings (server Me plus unexpired pending entries that the server has not counted yet).

NEW: the RankedEnd type, rankedEndOf(state, me) for a rated ranked game that is over, rankedLeftOf(state, me, marginMs) for leaving a running rated 2-player game, and storedIn(serverMe, end) (games in key > gamesBefore). The key comes from engine ratingKey(gameType, players.length, rules.rating.option).

Add the OnlineSessionDeps.onEnd({state, playerId, left}) callback and export the OnlineEnd type. Called once at gameOver (next to game_end analytics) and from close() when the game is not over (left: true). Wrapped in try/catch.
Add GameStoreDeps.onlineEnd, with the default onlineGameEnded from progress/appProgress in defaultGameStoreDeps. Pass it as onEnd to both OnlineSession constructions (goOnline, and goRanked's enter).
Re-export the OnlineEnd type and the rankedEnd helpers if the module index lists such types.

NEW: the RankedRefresh class (injected timers). Shows the result optimistically, polls fetchMe on a backoff until storedIn, then refreshes progress and the card. Handles the unrated and left schedules, dedups by gameId, supersedes 'left', and has stop().

Add the rankedRefresh() singleton and onlineGameEnded(OnlineEnd). In startProgress: stop rankedRefresh on sign-out or another owner and in the returned stop; the foreground handler also calls refreshMeIfStale().
Export rankedRefresh, onlineGameEnded, RankedRefresh and its types.

Add AuthDeps.now (optional) and module state for pendingRatings, lastServerReadAt and the request seq (reset in setAuthDeps, forgetLocal and needsProfile). adopt() merges pending ratings via withPendingRatings and caches the raw server Me. New exports: fetchMe() (returns the server Me, with a seq guard and a uid check), refreshMeIfStale(), and showRankedResult(end) (in-memory patch plus a pending entry with TTL). refreshMe() becomes a wrapper of fetchMe.
Export fetchMe, refreshMeIfStale, showRankedResult.
Focus effect: refreshMeIfStale() instead of the meOffline-only refreshMe(). Update the doc comment.
Keep leave()'s ranked refreshMe; update the comment to say the session-level refresh covers every other exit (back, swipe, game-screen home, leaving a running game, background).
Tests for ratingEntryAfter, withRatingEntry and withPendingRatings.
NEW: tests for rankedEndOf, rankedLeftOf and storedIn.
NEW: RankedRefresh with ManualClock/ManualScheduler.
onEnd called once at gameOver (left false), from close() mid-game (left true), not from close() after over, and never thrown through.
startOnline sessions get deps.onlineEnd.
The match's session (enter at 'found') gets deps.onlineEnd; a game over in it calls it once.

Tests for showRankedResult, the pending merge in fetchMe/refreshMe, TTL expiry (injected now), raw cache, refreshMeIfStale throttle, the seq guard for out-of-order answers, and sign-out clearing pending.
The foreground also reads GET /v1/me (throttled); onlineGameEnded ignored when signed out; stop() stops rankedRefresh.
Home focus re-reads /v1/me when stale even online, and the card shows the server's new rating; no re-read within minIntervalMs.

Extend: (a) the server stores the game late, after 'לבית' was pressed: Home never flips back to 1200 and ends on the stored rating; (b) leaving results without 'לבית' (router.back(), as Android back does): Home shows the new rating after the poll confirms. Align the match player id with the account's Me.id where the optimistic patch is asserted.

§4.3 (Home): add a line saying that after a ranked game the card's ratings update immediately from the game's result (computed by the server), are confirmed against the server in the background, and that level/XP/league/stats update once the server has stored the game, with no restart needed. Optionally the same note in §12.

Check 2, step 6: add checks that the new rating shows on Home also when leaving the results with Android Back (or the iOS swipe), when pressing 'לבית' immediately, and after background → foreground without a restart; and that level/XP and the games/win%/streak numbers update within a few seconds.
Row '5. בית': note that after a ranked game the ratings, level and XP update without restarting the app (also when leaving the results via Back).
Optional: line 171 'והדירוג מתעדכן' → 'והדירוג מתעדכן בבית בלי הפעלה מחדש'.

tests: rankedEnd.test.ts: rankedEndOf on a rated 2p game that is over (players with rating/ratedGames, option B) → key 'fast', change = mine, gamesBefore = ratedGames, provisionalGames from rules, expectsStored true, waitMs 0
rankedEndOf with rules.rating.option 'A' → key 'fast-2p'; with 3 players → 'fast-3p'

rankedLeftOf: running rated 2p game → change null, expectsStored true, waitMs = rules.graceMs + margin; over game, 3–4 players or unrated → null
storedIn: true only when expectsStored and the server's entry for the key has games > gamesBefore; false for a missing key
accountApi.test.ts (me.ts): ratingEntryAfter → rating = after, games = gamesBefore+1, provisional = games < provisionalGames (9 → provisional false at 10), peak = max(peak, after)
withRatingEntry replaces only the matching key and returns the same object for an unknown key

withPendingRatings: an older server answer (fewer games) keeps the pending entry; a caught-up answer drops it; an expired pending entry gives the server's; a pending entry of another me.id is ignored; the returned pending map has only the kept ones

rankedRefresh: never stored → exactly confirmDelaysMs.length fetches, then refreshProgress once
rankedRefresh: fetchMe null (offline) keeps the schedule
rankedRefresh: the same gameId ended twice → handled once; an end after a 'left' for the same game supersedes it; a newer game cancels the older wait
rankedRefresh: unrated end (change null, expectsStored false) → no showResult, fetchMe + refreshProgress at each unratedDelaysMs entry
rankedRefresh: a 'left' end waits waitMs before the first read; stop() cancels pending timers

onlineSession.test.ts: onEnd called once with left:false when the game ends (also when a fresh snapshot of an over game arrives); close() mid-game calls it with left:true; close() after over does not; an onEnd that throws breaks nothing
gameStoreOnline/gameStoreRanked: deps.onlineEnd is passed to sessions from startOnline and from a ranked search's 'found'; game over → called once

authStore.test.ts: showRankedResult patches me.ratings in memory (status ready, playerId === me.id, change present) while ME_CACHE_KEY still holds the server copy; ignored when signed out, playerId differs, change null, or the key is unknown

authStore: after showRankedResult, refreshMe with the server not yet updated keeps the optimistic entry; after the fake server's row gets games+1, refreshMe shows the server's entry and the pending entry is gone
authStore: with injected now, after optimisticTtlMs an old server answer replaces the optimistic entry
authStore: refreshMeIfStale skips within minIntervalMs after initAuth's read, reads after the interval, and always reads when meOffline
authStore: two fetchMe in flight, the older resolving last is not adopted (seq guard); fetchMe returns the server's Me, and null on network errors
authStore: signOut/setAuthDeps clear pending ratings (a new sign-in never sees them)
appProgress.test.ts: foreground('active') calls GET /v1/me when stale (in addition to progress); onlineGameEnded does nothing when nobody is signed in; the stop() of startProgress stops rankedRefresh
HomeAccount.test.tsx: with the last read older than minIntervalMs, focusing Home re-reads /v1/me online and the card shows the new rating; within the interval no extra GET

ranked.e2e.test.tsx: 'לבית' pressed before the server stores → Home shows the new rating (optimistic), never flips to 1200, still shows it after the server stores; leaving results via router.back() (like Android back) then going Home → new rating after the poll
rankedResults.test.tsx: unchanged expectations still pass (leave() calls refreshMe once)
Run `npm test` (root) before declaring done
docs: docs/01-SPEC.md §4.3: the Home card's ratings update right after a ranked game (from the server's result), are confirmed against the server in the background, and level/XP/league/stats follow once stored, with no restart
docs/STAGE9-10-DEVICE-CHECKS.md check 2 step 6: new device checks (Back/swipe from results, immediate 'לבית', background→foreground, XP/level/stats)
docs/QA-CHECKLIST.md row '5. בית': rating, level and XP update after a ranked game without restarting
risks: Cross-item dependency: the retire / opponent-quit rating rules (other items) change which players get a RatingChange in GameResult.ratingChanges. The client's confirmation (games > gamesBefore when a change exists) relies on the server's applyRatingChanges adding 1 to games exactly for the players present there. If the server ever stores a delta-0 game without adding 1 to games, or adds 1 without a RatingChange, storedIn must follow it.

Optimistic display: for up to optimisticTtlMs the phone may show a rating the server has not stored (if the write failed for good). It self-corrects on the next read after the TTL. The cache stores only server answers.

Shared files with other items: onlineSession.ts, gameStore.ts, app/game.tsx and app/results/[id].tsx are likely also touched by the black-screen and connection-grace items. Keep the onEnd hook minimal to ease merging.
Jest: the global useGameStore now wires onlineGameEnded. Its timers must be stopped (startProgress stop / onAuth owner change) so e2e tests don't leak timers between tests.
A retryOnline closing the old session fires a 'left' wait that only stops when the new session's end supersedes it: a few extra GET /v1/me. Harmless.
3–4 player games left mid-way are not polled (they are stored only when the whole game ends). They rely on the throttled Home focus and foreground reads.
History (/history) and my player card load on open: if opened within ~1 s of the end they can still miss the game until reopened (outside this item).

decisions.question: להציג בבית את הדירוג החדש מיד בסוף המשחק? המספר הוא מהתוצאה שהשרת חישב, אותו מספר שמסך התוצאות מציג, עוד לפני שהשרת סיים לשמור. או לחכות לאישור מהשרת, שמגיע בדרך כלל תוך 1–3 שניות?
decisions.recommendedDefault: להציג מיד ולאמת ברקע. אם השרת לא שמר תוך 2 דקות, מוצג הערך של השרת.

decisions.question: גם ה־XP, הרמה והליגה בבית יתעדכנו מיד (חישוב בטלפון), או רק אחרי שהשרת שמר?
decisions.recommendedDefault: רק אחרי שהשרת שמר: הם מגיעים כמה שניות אחרי הדירוג, בלי חישוב כפול בטלפון.

decisions.question: כל כמה זמן לכל היותר הבית, וגם חזרה לאפליקציה מהרקע, יקראו מחדש את הפרופיל מהשרת?
decisions.recommendedDefault: 30 שניות (accountConfig.refresh.minIntervalMs), ומיד אם הפרופיל נטען מהטלפון באופליין.

decisions.question: כפתור Back של Android במסך התוצאות חוזר היום למסך סוג המשחק. שיתנהג כמו 'לבית'?
decisions.recommendedDefault: לא לשנות במסגרת הבאג הזה: התיקון לא תלוי בזה. אפשר להחליט בנפרד, יחד עם תיקוני המסך השחור.
